Let’s reshape how the world works together.

A career at HP can help you build the tomorrow you want. Find opportunities to grow professionally while helping build a better world.

Channel your passions, impact humanity and your community.

With over 100 career categories spanning the globe, there’s more than one way to make an impact here. Whether you’re just beginning your career, considering a change, or aiming to advance, HP is a place where careers, people, and innovation thrive.

Explore Careers with HP

At HP, we look at the entire range of your experience for transferrable skills. As a global community of professionals, we learn from each other—both on the job and through structured development. You’re encouraged to apply even if some of your qualifications do not perfectly match the job requirements.

Why HP?

When you join HP, you’re investing in your future—and so are we. You have priorities beyond work. That’s why we offer flexibility, support, and benefits that help you shape the life you want.

HP Stories

Executive Careers

HP inspires future executive leaders to make a lasting impact while also co-creating our dynamic culture. Guided by HP’s Leadership Principles, we offer comprehensive leadership development support that empowers you and your teams to grow. Join us and help shape the future the HP way.
Explore Careers

Internships

Bring your ambitions and discover what’s possible. HP offers internship opportunities in over 50 countries, including summer programs, special programs, and year-round placements, that offer meaningful projects, learning, fun and exposure to our leadership. Our CEO started as an HP intern!

Explore Careers

Graduates

Start your career by developing the future of work at HP. You will solution real challenges, develop strong networks, and learn and grow in your career across a global community of innovators.

Explore Careers

Alternative Pathways

HP’s Alternative Pathways offer opportunities for individuals from different career backgrounds, including military veterans, experienced employees returning to work, and early-career talent who learn on the job. This program helps unlock potential while meeting business needs.

HP Stories

Belong to a Global Community

Belonging isn’t something you have to earn at HP. It’s cultivated every day. Our legendary culture—the HP Way— gives all employees a framework for doing the right things at work and within our communities.

Belong to a Global Community

Belonging isn’t something you have to earn at HP. It’s cultivated every day. Our legendary culture—the HP Way— gives all employees a framework for doing the right things at work and within our communities.

  • You’ll collaborate with colleagues around the world
  • Our Business Resource Groups (BRGs) will help you stay connected, share knowledge, support each other, and gain cultural insights
  • We excel in identifying and supporting global recognition, team events, and shared success across our organization
  • We are all connected through our passion for innovation and progress, giving our work real purpose
Inclusion at HP

Growth at HP isn’t just encouraged—it’s part of the job.

Your personal and professional development is encouraged, so you can build the career you want. Be part of a global laboratory where different perspectives and experiences will help you solve problems in new ways, pushing our technology to improve.
  • Engage in exciting and collaborative work that is destined to create real-world impact
  • Enjoy access to global learning platforms, courses, and certifications
  • Empower your career with mobility across departments and geographies
  • Engage in leadership development programs to build next-generation skills
  • Jump-start your career your way with internships, graduate programs, and early-career opportunities
  • Grow in a culture of continuous feedback and career development support

Purpose in Action: HP’s Commitment Beyond Work

As one of the world’s most sustainable and ethical companies in tech, HP is committed to leading with integrity and innovation. Our ambitious priorities reflect the needs of our customers. Our programs and strategies are designed to create a better world—and we hold ourselves accountable.

A Legacy of Values. The Stewardship of Progress

At HP, the way we work is just as important as the work we do. The HP Way began as a philosophy—and today, it powers how we innovate, connect, and lead with purpose.
